::api-operation{method="GET" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/unbilled_charges"}
#docs
Cursor-paginated, oldest first unless `sort_by[desc]=created_at`. Scope with `subscription` or `customer`; filter with `status[op]` (`pending` | `billed` | `voided` — a deleted charge is `voided`) and `created_at[op]`. `period_end` uses the invoice-line convention, as `POST …/charges` answers. `invoice` is set once billed.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | Business id (biz_…) |

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `subscription` | `string` | no | Only unbilled charges on this subscription (sub_…). |
| `customer` | `string` | no | Only unbilled charges for this customer (cus_…). |
| `status[in]` | `string` | no | Any enum operator: status[is\|is_not\|in\|not_in] |
| `created_at[after]` | `string` | no | Any date operator: created_at[before\|after\|on\|between\|…] |
| `limit` | `integer` | no | Maximum number of rows to return. |
| `starting_after` | `string` | no | Opaque cursor from a previous `next_cursor`. |
| `sort_by[desc]` | `string` | no | Sort descending by this field. |
